The following events took place in '''3,978 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*A pureblood [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Unidentified Sith emissary|emissary]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] meets with [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], together with whom he [[Search for Dramath the Second's remains|discovers]] the [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]] of the long-[[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath the Second]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]].<ref name="Revan" />
